अरे यारों, अनन्या पांडे ने नेपोटिज्म डिबेट पर ऐसा जवाब दिया है कि सब देखते रह गए! 🍿🔥

अनन्या पांडे ने शनिवार को नई दिल्ली में 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit में हिस्सा लिया। 🎙️

जेन ज़ेड को लेकर अनन्या का कहना है कि उनकी पीढ़ी को बेवजह बदनाम किया जाता है, क्योंकि उनकी सफलता की परिभाषा अलग है। 🤷‍♀️

फिल्म Student of the Year 2 से डेब्यू करने वाली अनन्या ने नेपोटिज्म पर बात करते हुए कहा कि अपनी प्रिविलेज को न स्वीकारने का कोई मतलब नहीं है। ✨

एक्टर चंकी पांडे की बेटी अनन्या का कहना है कि उन्हें अपने पिता की बेटी होने पर बहुत गर्व है और वह इस रिश्ते के साथ कोई नेगेटिविटी नहीं चाहती हैं। 🙌

उनका कहना है कि वह हर दिन उठकर भगवान का शुक्रिया अदा करती हैं कि उन्हें अपना सपना जीने का मौका मिला और वह खुद को लकी मानती हैं। 🙏

टाइगर श्रॉफ को मिली धमकियों के बाद फिल्म इंडस्ट्री में डर के माहौल पर अनन्या का कहना है कि यह बहुत डरावना है और इससे सबकी सुरक्षा को लेकर लोग ज्यादा सतर्क होंगे। 🎬

तो दोस्तों, क्या आपको लगता है कि स्टार किड्स के लिए इंडस्ट्री में सफर वाकई आसान होता है? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.title: Ananya Panday on the nepotism debate: I am proud to be my father's daughter; thank God every day I get to live my dream
ctx.summary: Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, Ananya Panday said Gen Z is unfairly stereotyped and has a different definition of success.
ctx.text:
Lazy, entitled and unwilling to put in the hours? Ananya Panday isn’t buying the stereotypes surrounding Gen Z. The 28-year-old actor, speaking at the 24th Hindustan Times Leadership Summit in New Delhi on Saturday, had a spirited defence of her generation.
“I think Gen Z is badnaam for no reason honestly!” she said, adding that the younger generation simply defines success differently. “Just the definition of success is different. Maybe for the old generation, while growing up, there was only one kind of success. You had to follow a certain path to get that. Gen Z is a little different. I thrive on chaos, love working for as many hours as possible. But maybe someone else in my generation is equally successful and doesn’t work as hard. That’s their way of doing it," she added.
The conversation inevitably turned to nepotism, a debate that has followed Ananya since her Bollywood debut in Student of the Year 2 (2019). But the actor isn’t shying away from her privilege or her father, actor Chunky Panday’s legacy.
“I think there’s no point in not acknowledging it. I am very proud to be my father’s daughter. I don’t ever not want to be associated with Chunky Panday, so I don’t want to have any negative connotation with that association,” she said, adding, “Contrary to whatever people may believe about me, I wake up every day and thank God I get to live my dream. I am lucky, privileged.”
As for the current atmosphere of fear in the film industry post the threats issued to Tiger Shroff, Ananya said, “It’s very scary. This will make people less lax about safety measures for everyone involved; I don’t think it’s just about actors’ safety, but crowds’ safety too.”
